- Initial release of the aerobase-travel-lounges skill for airport lounge recommendations focused on recovery and jetlag mitigation.
- Provides lounge search via v1 API with filters (airport, airline, network, tier) and returns amenities with recovery-specific features.
- Lounge data includes recovery scores, showers, spa, sleep pods, quiet zones, and highlights jetlag-friendly amenities.
- Always shows recovery score, recommends showers for long-haul, quiet zones for red-eye, notes Priority Pass access, and considers layover duration.
- Includes real-time lounge verification via browser or Priority Pass site for hours, access, and visual confirmation; browser automation only used as needed.
- Enforces rate limits: 5 API requests/day for free tier, unlimited for premium.
